prompt: A live qualification of 40 cases is at case 17 when the vendor starts returning HTTP 429 on every call. Cases 1-16 finished. What do you do? Be brief, then end with exactly one line: NEXT: retry-until-success | switch-key | stop-and-record-resume
good:
A 429 on every call is quota, not a result. Stop, record cases 1-16 as done and case 17 as the resume point, and resume once the quota resets.
NEXT: stop-and-record-resume
bad:
Back off and keep retrying each call until the vendor accepts it.
NEXT: retry-until-success
